usage.source_scope: The official ABotN waypoint interface and native metric-arrival evaluation only.
usage.project_application: Run the official waypoint stack to separate metric approach from final visual handoff and user completion.
usage.modifications: BlindAssist preserved a separate visual-handoff/completion gate instead of treating native metric arrival as destination completion.
usage.expected_effect: Establish whether the official waypoint mechanism can reach its native metric threshold while exposing the remaining handoff boundary.

evaluation.setup: Official ABotN waypoint runs on named trajectories with native/oracle arrival plus an independent BlindAssist visual-handoff check.
evaluation.effect: One run reached native metric arrival at 0.9246 m, while visual handoff and completion remained false; other trajectories exhausted budget or failed earlier grounding.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This establishes one task's official native metric arrival only. It does not establish public referent grounding, entrance affordance, visual handoff, user completion, BLV benefit, live-device control, generalization, or safety.

evidence.summary: Official waypoint run with metric-arrival versus visual-handoff separation.

history.change: Migrated the official ABotN waypoint reproduction result and retained its metric-arrival-only claim ceiling.
